Stage 4 · Java foundations

String Immutability

Strings never change. Every “edit” builds new — safe to share, costly in loops.

⏱ 12 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Photocopies, not edits

toUpperCase photocopies; original shelved.

📕

Printed book vs whiteboard. s.toUpperCase() PHOTOCOPIES in caps; the original sits unchanged. Photocopying 10,000 pages in a loop? Madness — whiteboard (StringBuilder) next lesson.

ProgramRead each line in order
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    String s = "java";
    s.toUpperCase(); // photocopy made... and dropped on the floor
    System.out.println(s); // still "java"!
    s = s.toUpperCase(); // NOW catch the copy
    System.out.println(s); // "JAVA"
  }
}

Line 4’s result dropped on the floor; reassignment keeps it.

java
